title: Social Worker Salary Australia: Hourly to Annual Pay Guide
description: Learn how to convert a social worker salary Australia from hourly to annual using a 38-hour week, 52-week year. Includes award rates, tax, and super.
salarySummary: A social worker under the Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award earns at least $27.55 per hour (Level 1, pay point 1), which equates to $54,436 per year based on a 38-hour week.

faqs.q: How do I calculate my annual salary from my hourly rate as a social worker?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then multiply by 52. For a standard 38-hour week, the formula is: hourly rate × 38 × 52. For example, at $27.55 per hour (Level 1, pay point 1 under the Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award), your annual gross pay would be $27.55 × 38 × 52 = $54,436. This assumes you work the same hours every week with no unpaid overtime or penalty rates.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the National Minimum Wage and the award rate for social workers?
faqs.a: The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour ($1,004.90 per week for 38 hours). However, social workers are typically covered by the Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award, which sets higher minimum rates. For example, the award’s Level 1 pay point 1 rate is $27.55 per hour. Award rates also include penalty rates, allowances, and casual loading (25% on top for casual employees). Always check the relevant award or enterprise agreement for your exact entitlement.

faqs.q: How much tax and super will I pay on a social worker salary?
faqs.a: For the 2026–27 financial year, resident tax rates are: nil up to $18,200, 15% from $18,201 to $45,000, 30% from $45,001 to $135,000, 37% from $135,001 to $190,000, and 45% above $190,000. Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. Superannuation guarantee is 12% of your ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For a $54,436 annual salary, estimated tax (including Medicare) would be approximately $7,047, and super would be $6,532.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding Your Social Worker Salary Australia

If you're searching for a **social worker salary Australia**, you're likely looking at hourly rates or annual offers. This guide helps you convert between the two using a standard 38-hour week and a 52-week year. We'll also cover the relevant award, tax, and superannuation so you can see your full picture.

### The Conversion Formula

The basic formula to turn an hourly rate into annual gross pay is:

**Hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

We assume 38 hours per week because that's the ordinary full-time hours under most awards and the National Minimum Wage. If you work part-time or different hours, adjust the number accordingly. The result is your gross annual income before tax and other deductions.

### Award Rates for Social Workers

Social workers are commonly covered by the **Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award** (MA000100). The Fair Work Ombudsman publishes official pay guides for this award. According to the latest guide, rates apply from the first full pay period on or after 1 December 2026.

For a **Social and Community Services Employee** at Level 1, pay point 1, the minimum hourly rate is **$27.55**. That gives:

- **Weekly**: $27.55 × 38 = $1,046.90
- **Fortnightly**: $1,046.90 × 2 = $2,093.80
- **Annual**: $27.55 × 38 × 52 = **$54,436**

Higher classifications pay more. For example, Level 2 pay point 1 is $36.22 per hour ($71,528 per year), and Level 4 pay point 1 is $46.70 per hour ($92,283 per year).

### National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

The **National Minimum Wage** from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour ($1,004.90 per week) for award/agreement-free employees. However, most social workers are covered by an award or enterprise agreement that sets higher rates. The award also includes penalty rates for weekends, public holidays, and shift work, plus allowances for things like first aid, on-call, and sleepovers.

### Casual Loading

If you work as a casual social worker, you get a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate. For Level 1 pay point 1, that's $27.55 × 1.25 = $34.44 per hour. Casual loading compensates for not receiving paid leave. When using [the timesheet](/) tool, you can check the casual loading box to add it automatically – never enter a rate that already includes loading.

### Superannuation

Super guarantee is **12%** of your ordinary earnings, paid by your employer on top of your salary. It's not deducted from your pay. For the $54,436 annual example, super would be $6,532 per year. The super guarantee is capped at the maximum contribution base of $270,830 (2026–27).

### Tax on Your Social Worker Salary

Using the 2026–27 resident tax rates:

| Taxable income | Tax on this income |
| --- | --- |
| $0 – $18,200 | Nil |
| $18,201 – $45,000 | 15¢ for each $1 over $18,200 |
| $45,001 – $135,000 | $4,020 plus 30¢ for each $1 over $45,000 |
| $135,001 – $190,000 | $31,020 plus 37¢ for each $1 over $135,000 |
| Over $190,000 | $51,370 plus 45¢ for each $1 over $190,000 |

Plus **Medicare levy** of 2% (using 2025–26 single reduction thresholds as 2026–27 were not confirmed).

For a $54,436 annual gross, estimated tax and Medicare is about **$7,047**, leaving a take-home of roughly **$47,389** per year. Use [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) for a detailed calculator.

### Fortnightly and Weekly Breakdown

Knowing your fortnightly pay helps with budgeting. For the $27.55 rate:

- **Weekly**: $1,046.90
- **Fortnightly**: $2,093.80
- **Monthly (approx)**: $4,536

After tax, fortnightly take-home is around **$1,822**.

### What This Guide Doesn't Cover

This estimate assumes a consistent 38-hour week with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, allowances, or salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only. It does not deduct HELP repayments, Medicare levy surcharge, or salary packaging. Always check your specific award or agreement. For more detail, see [pay guides](/blog) and [reference tables](/data).

### Summary

A **social worker salary Australia** can be easily converted from hourly to annual using the 38-hour, 52-week formula. The award minimum for entry-level social workers is $27.55 per hour, giving $54,436 per year. Higher classifications, penalties, and casual loading increase that figure. Use the [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool to try different rates, and remember that super is paid on top of your salary.
